commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Square 1:1 illustration for a fantasy army card, artwork only, NO frame, symbols, lettering or card layout. Match the attached lion battle image VERY CLOSELY in rendering style: extremely simplified 2D hand-painted angular cutout shapes, large flat matte color blocks, just TWO OR THREE discrete cel-painted shade planes per material, irregular dark ink contours where necessary, chunky anatomy, tiny to no texture. The approved reference reads like a game cutout, not a detailed illustration: NO realistic faces, no painterly portrait realism, no dense details, no shiny metal, no gradients or fine brush rendering. Use reference as STYLE AND PALETTE only; do not include the lion or copy the fight. Background is a dark low contrast muted navy and teal space with a few very large ground and wall shapes, no environment crowding. The subject must be warmer and much brighter than all background, wholly contained inside the art, readable with breathing room around its silhouette. Infantry must read as a small cohesive group, with one dominant lead silhouette, not an elaborate posed portrait. Keep lighting simple, favor warm ochre, dull iron and muted fabric like the reference.
